dataset_uses.purpose: Train CatBoost classifier to predict ultralow κL (κPET ≤ 2 W/mK)

evidence.text: We perform ensemble learning on the labeled local database for directly classifying ultralow κL, training a robust CatBoost classifier45.
Here, materials with κPET not exceeding 2 W/mK are labeled as 1, which are considered to possess ultralow κL; otherwise, they are labeled as 0, signifying non-ultralow κL.
